questions.label: Have you been able to contact them directly?
Do you know their exact location?
Is anyone else nearby who could help?

situations.label: Medical emergency
actions: Call local emergency medical services immediately — this takes priority over everything else.
If you can reach the person, ask about symptoms, consciousness, and breathing so you can relay this to responders.
Identify anyone physically close to the person who can stay with them until help arrives.
Do not attempt medical procedures beyond basic first aid unless trained.
If there is no response within a few minutes, escalate to additional contacts and share the last known location with them.

situations.label: Accident
actions: Call emergency services and give the exact or approximate location.
Try to confirm the person's condition and whether they are conscious and responsive.
Ask anyone nearby to assist until professional help arrives — do not move an injured person unnecessarily.
Share basic first-aid guidance only if no professional help is immediately available.
If contact is lost, escalate to other trusted contacts and consider notifying local authorities with the location.

situations.label: Assault or threat
actions: Call the police immediately — this situation involves a potential threat to safety.
Do not attempt to intervene in person or approach the location alone.
If safe to do so, try to confirm the person's status without escalating the danger to them.
Identify two or more trusted people who can travel to the location together, never alone.
If there is no response, escalate to police and other emergency contacts without delay.

situations.label: Trapped or unsafe location
actions: Call the police or relevant rescue services and share the known location.
Try to contact the person directly to understand their situation and confirm they are not in immediate danger.
Reach out to people who live or work near the location and may be able to check in quickly.
Do not go to the location alone if it appears unsafe — send two or three trusted people together, or wait for official responders.
If there is no response within a short window, escalate to police with the last known location.

situations.label: Lost or unreachable
actions: Try contacting the person through all available channels first.
If there's no response, notify others who were with them last or who know their routine.
Share the last known location with police if there's no contact within a reasonable time.
Coordinate with nearby trusted contacts to check likely locations together, not alone.
Escalate to formal missing-person procedures if there's an extended period with no contact.

situations.label: Natural disaster
actions: Check official local alerts and emergency services for the affected area.
Try to confirm the person's safety and location through any available communication.
Identify shelters or safe zones nearby that the person could reach.
Coordinate with other trusted contacts rather than traveling into an affected area alone.
Escalate to local disaster-response authorities if there is no contact for an extended period.
